speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, can you tell me how many days old your baby is now?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (due to insufficient intake/dehydration) with a differential for Breast Milk Jaundice given the age of onset.

REQUEST TEST: Serum Bilirubin, Blood Type, Coombs Test, Urinalysis, Stool Analysis.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound.
